bus.via: Sofia Central Bus Station to Plovdiv Central Train Station Bus Stop

trips.route_note: Frequent direct trains and buses run from Sofia to Plovdiv in roughly 2 to 2.5 hours; the train station is a short walk from the old town.
see: Old Town cobbled streets and Revival houses
trips.why: Frequent direct trains take about 2h 29m and the station is a short walk from the old town.
know: Book ahead in peak summer season
The old town is best explored on foot from the station
Allow a full day to see the Roman theatre and old town
